sources.entry: Dolibarr - Modern CRM software package to manage your company or foundation activity (contacts, suppliers, invoices, orders, stocks, agenda, accounting, ...). (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 PHP/deb

summary.one_liner: Dolibarr is an open-source ERP and CRM suite written in PHP for managing a company's or foundation's contacts, invoices, orders, stock, agenda, accounting and more.
summary.what_it_does: Dolibarr covers business activities through optional modules: third parties (customers, prospects, suppliers) and contacts, products and services with stock/warehouse and inventory, bills of materials and manufacturing orders, commercial proposals, customer and purchase orders, invoices and payments, and a point of sale. It also includes finance features such as bank accounts, SEPA direct debit and credit transfer, accounting, loans and donations, plus collaboration tools (shared agenda with ical/vcal, projects and tasks, surveys), HR tools (leave, expense reports, timesheets, recruitment) and electronic document management. The README lists around 100 default modules and more addons on the Dolistore marketplace. It runs on a web server with PHP and MariaDB, MySQL or PostgreSQL, and the README describes REST and SOAP APIs, multi-language and multi-currency support, and country-specific tax features. Upgrades are described as possible from any version after 2.8.
use_cases: run a small business's invoicing and orders
manage employee leave, expenses and timesheets
run a foundation's memberships and donations
how_to_run: Install PHP and a supported database (MariaDB, MySQL or PostgreSQL) on a web server such as Apache or Nginx
git clone -b x.y (where x.y is the main version, e.g. 19.0) the Dolibarr repository
Point the web server root to dolibarr/htdocs
Create an empty htdocs/conf/conf.php and give the web server user write permission
Open the install/ page in a browser and follow the installer
Alternatively use the Docker image, DoliWamp, DoliDeb or DoliRpm packages
notable: Modular design with around 100 optional modules that can be enabled individually
Upgrades supported from any version after 2.8 without breakage, per the README
Country-specific tax and invoicing features, such as Spanish IRPF, French NPR VAT, and ZATCA QR codes
Packaged installers for Windows, Debian/Ubuntu and Red Hat-family systems
caveats: README lists features Dolibarr does not yet support: task dependencies in projects, a payroll module, and native embedded webmail
Many advanced features and some country modules are external or addons, some with costs via Dolistore or commercial support
Requires a PHP web server and database to self-host; the README points to the Wiki for exact requirements
